usedFor: When a Zoom meeting ends, Calendly makes a booking link for the follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting ends” in Zoom, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Ending is the natural moment to offer a follow-up slot, with a link to pass on.

watchOut: “When a participant joins a meeting” also reaches this action, which would make a link per join.
